summary.text: Melissa Brewer is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 130 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A longtime public school educator who has worked as a teacher, principal and superintendent, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she supports property tax reform and a state commission to uncover fraud.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Brewer earned a high school diploma from Governor Mifflin High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 1990 and a graduate degree from Kutztown University of Pennsylvania in 1993.
Her career has been in education administration.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has spent her entire career in public education as a teacher, principal and superintendent, and that she is a lifetime resident of Berks County and a 19-year resident of House District 130.
Brewer defeated Mitch Micale in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for District 130, and she faces Democrat Erik Bonnett in the general election for a seat with no incumbent.

In the survey she described property tax reform and a new way to fund public schools as a priority, and she said she supports an independent Pennsylvania commission to explore and remove fraud at the state level.

She also said she supports voter identification requirements and Second Amendment rights, and named education, early childhood and policies affecting older Pennsylvanians as her areas of policy interest.
